mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_inbound_event (bot_binding_id, msg_id_hash, aibot_id, trace_id, run_id, stream_id, from_user_hash, chat_type, chat_id_hash, msg_type, event_type, payload_hash, status, duplicate_count, first_received_at, last_received_at) VALUES (#{botBindingId}, #{msgIdHash}, #{aibotId}, #{traceId}, #{runId}, #{streamId}, #{fromUserHash}, #{chatType}, #{chatIdHash}, #{msgType}, #{eventType}, #{payloadHash}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1, last_received_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, bot_binding_id, msg_id_hash, aibot_id, trace_id, run_id, stream_id, from_user_hash, chat_type, chat_id_hash, msg_type, event_type, payload_hash, status, duplicate_count, first_received_at, last_received_at FROM fbs_inbound_event WHERE id = #{id}
